verdict.rationale: Xero is proprietary SaaS accounting software, and the evidence pack never shows its core product source published under an open license. The public GitHub repos (xero-node SDK, OpenAPI descriptions, MCP server) are developer-facing integration artifacts, not the product's own source. The pack also names no license for any of them, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
